single_changed_variable: use the frozen V21 H4/M15/M5 signal only as an additional exit for inventory facing against its H4 direction
entry_policy: identical V16 source entries; V21 signals can never open, add, reverse, or extend a position

exit_policy.trigger: at the V21 executable fill open, close an existing same-pair position only when its direction is opposite the frozen V21 H4 direction
exit_policy.same_timestamp_order: apply the auxiliary exit first, then apply the V16 primary signal
exit_policy.price: the first executable BID/ASK open already frozen by the V21 completed-bar decision
exit_policy.max_age: retain V16 H384 expiry for inventory not closed by an earlier permitted event

rationale: V21 had no proposal-level entry edge. This arm tests the user's entry-versus-exit separation without pretending the same feature is a profitable entry signal.

evaluation.universe: same seven USD majors as V16
evaluation.allocation: seven fixed 1/7 sleeves; gross cap 1.0; no leverage tuning
evaluation.terminal_inventory: always liquidated and required to be zero

development_admission: normal and adverse equity multiples exceed 1.0 in the full walk and each standalone month
turnover and exit counts are reported
multiplicity: Count V22 as the second hypothesis in the H4-context short-timeframe family.
